questions.q: Which European king owned the Congo as his personal property?
questions.why: His rule caused millions of deaths.

questions.q: From which country did the DR Congo gain independence in 1960?
questions.why: It was called the Belgian Congo.

questions.q: Who was the DR Congo's first Prime Minister?
questions.why: He was killed in 1961.

questions.q: What did Mobutu rename the country in 1971?
questions.why: It became the DR Congo again in 1997.

questions.q: Who ruled the country as Mobutu Sese Seko from 1965 to 1997?
questions.why: He was overthrown by Laurent Kabila.

questions.q: Which province tried to break away in 1960?
questions.why: Moïse Tshombe led it.

questions.q: Which Congolese doctor won the 2018 Nobel Peace Prize?
questions.why: He treats survivors of sexual violence.

questions.q: Which 1998–2003 war is called 'Africa's World War'?
questions.why: Nine countries took part.

questions.q: Which rebel group seized Goma in 2025?
questions.why: It is backed by Rwanda, the UN says.

questions.q: Which explorer's search for Livingstone crossed the Congo?
questions.why: He later worked for Leopold II.

questions.q: What is the capital of the Democratic Republic of the Congo?
questions.why: It is Africa's largest French-speaking city.

questions.q: Which river is the deepest in the world?
questions.why: Parts are over 220 m deep.

questions.q: Which national park is Africa's oldest?
questions.why: It was founded in 1925.

questions.q: Which city across the river from Kinshasa is another capital?
questions.why: They are the closest capitals in the world, apart from Rome and Vatican City.

questions.q: Which active volcano near Goma has a lava lake?
questions.why: It erupted in 2021.

questions.q: Which rainforest park is Africa's largest tropical forest reserve?
questions.why: It protects bonobos.

questions.q: Which falls on the Congo River near Kisangani are the world's largest by flow?
questions.why: They were called Stanley Falls.

questions.q: Which 1974 boxing match was held in Kinshasa?
questions.why: Muhammad Ali beat George Foreman.

questions.q: Which NBA star from Kinshasa was famous for wagging his finger?
questions.why: He was a top shot-blocker.

questions.q: Which Congolese football club won the African Champions League five times?
questions.why: It is from Lubumbashi.

questions.q: Which dance music from Kinshasa spread across Africa?
questions.why: It is on UNESCO's list.

questions.q: Which Congolese musician was called 'the Grand Maître'?
questions.why: He led the band OK Jazz.

questions.q: Which singer was called the 'King of Rumba Rock'?
questions.why: He promoted La Sape.

questions.q: Who has been President of the DR Congo since 2019?
questions.why: He is the son of Étienne Tshisekedi.

questions.q: Which great ape lives only in the DR Congo?
questions.why: It is very close to humans.

questions.q: Which forest animal is the DR Congo's national animal?
questions.why: It looks like a zebra and giraffe mixed.

questions.q: What is the currency of the DR Congo?
questions.why: Its code is CDF.

questions.q: Which metal used in phone batteries comes mostly from the DR Congo?
questions.why: It produces about 70% of the world's supply.

questions.q: Which language is official in the DR Congo?
questions.why: Lingala, Swahili, Kikongo and Tshiluba are national languages.

questions.q: Which dandies in Kinshasa wear designer clothes?
questions.why: Members are called sapeurs.
